## [Unrealiable delivery date and poor communication](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/696efbe0be94e9984b9a1faa)
We ordered the Yucca sofa with Lulu & Georgia on 10/08 and had an advertised delivery window of 6-8 weeks. We were looking forward to host some holiday celebrations at our house with the new sofa. However, the delivery date got pushed out further and further. We couldn’t host any celebrations and whenever we were given a new date, the delivery date got pushed out again on the days the sofa was supposed to be shipped. Very frustrating experience. The chat was not reachable a couple of times and email responses often took 2 days or longer. We are in week 15 now and still no trace of the sofa. We decided to cancel the order today and order another sofa somewhere else. Another unusual and unpleasant store practice is that the purchase price gets charged full at the moment of purchase and not when the sofa is shipped (as is common with many other stores). Therefore, the money is gone fast, but the merchandise doesn’t come on time. I would not recommend the store.

October 8, 2025

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

Jan 20, 2026

Thank you for sharing this feedback. We’re very sorry to hear about the frustration caused by the delays and communication issues surrounding this order. We understand how disappointing it is when a delivery timeline shifts repeatedly, especially when plans were made around the original estimate.

While our delivery windows are estimates and can be impacted by factors such as supplier production timelines and freight delays, we recognize that clearer and more timely communication is essential — and we regret that this fell short here. We also understand how difficult it is to wait when an item has already been paid for, even though charging at the time of purchase is our standard practice to secure production and inventory.

We appreciate this feedback, as it helps us identify where improvements are needed, particularly around proactive updates and response times. We’re sorry this experience led to a cancellation and appreciate the time taken to share these concerns.
